This is a rematch. Milwaukee is no longer an underdog.

research.facts:
2026 Season's Wildest Stats
**Key Facts (MEDIUM-HIGH confidence — ESPN/MLB.com):**
- Astros first team to make playoffs with exactly 81-81 record (first time in MLB history a team made playoffs at .500 in a full season) — WON AL West
- White Sox: Won 81 games after three consecutive 100+ loss seasons (previous high was 70 wins; new record)
- 16 players homered in their MLB debut in 2026 — new MLB record (previous was 13 in 2022)
- Washington Nationals: 42 blown saves — new MLB record
- Nasim Nuñez (Nationals 2B): Led MLB in steals with 47, despite a .529 OPS
- Jacob Misiorowski: Shattered velocity records for starting pitchers
- Milwaukee only 32.6% of runs scored via HR (MLB avg: 40.6%) — unusual small-ball profile for a 103-win team
research.sources:
- Sources: ESPN, MLB.com
- Note: "Astros made playoffs 81-81" is MEDIUM confidence — verify; Houston won AL West despite 81-81 is the stated fact
